NOT useful for HVAC/plumbing/electrical trades. Score these as low-urgency leads (no permit_freshness boost) but tag them as 'pipeline_signal'.

_block_comment: Agent-3: parcel/assessor/lien/license_roster substitutes for the 7 dead-permit states (ME, MS, NH, OK, RI, UT, WV). Henri's wedge can absorb these via the regrid-parcel enricher + a new lien/license enricher. data_layer field marks intended consumer. NON-PERMIT entries are inserted by _ingest-missing-permits.mjs only with --include-non-permit flag (not the default).

jurisdiction: Utah State Construction Registry (SCR) — GOLD STANDARD
notes: THE BEST construction lead-gen data source nationally. UT law requires every contractor on a $5k+ job to file a preliminary notice within 20 days. Returns project_name, project_address, owner, original_contractor, prelim_notice_filer, license_number, filing_date, amount. Search-only HTML — needs ASP.NET ViewState scrape. Phase 4 priority above Honolulu DPP.

VERIFIED 2026-05-08: HTTP 200, 1,586,356 parcels statewide, refreshed quarterly. Geometry+metadata layer (PARCEL_ID, PARCEL_ADD, RECORDER, ParcelsCur, County, CoParcel_URL). NO owner names here — must pair with Parcels_LIR (next entry).

PRIMARY UT SUBSTITUTE. Companion to UtahStatewideParcels. Fields: OWN_NAME, OWN_ADDR, OWN_CITY, OWN_ZIP, TOTAL_MKT_VALUE, BLDG_SQFT, BUILT_YR, EFFBUILT_YR, LAST_SALE_DT, LAST_SALE_AMT, USE_DESC. Quarterly refresh. The trifecta for predicting upcoming construction: owner + last_sale + building characteristics. Ingest URL needs API endpoint resolution (this is the dataset landing page; probe the underlying FeatureServer via opendata.gis.utah.gov DCAT).

jurisdiction: Utah DOPL — License Roster (BULK CSV available)
notes: BEST license-roster source of all 7 states. UT DOPL publishes a downloadable monthly CSV of ALL active licenses (general contractors B/E1/R100, electricians, plumbers, HVAC). license_number, name, address, phone, profession, status, expiration. Bulk download — no scraping required. Direct ingest target.

PRIMARY WV SUBSTITUTE. VERIFIED 2026-05-08: HTTP 200, 1,499,827 records. Fields: Owner1, Owner2, FullOwnerName, OwnerAddress, NewOwner (recent-transfer flag — STRONGEST construction-leading-indicator), NewBook, NewPage, DeedBook, DeedPage, PhysicalAddress, YearBuilt, LandUse, OccupancyDescription, BasementType, ExteriorWallType, BusinessLivingArea, StructureArea, DwellingValue, CommercialValue, LandAppraisal, BuildingAppraisal, TotalAppraisal, TaxYear. Quarterly refresh from county assessors. Closes WV in ONE endpoint.

VERIFIED 2026-05-08: HTTP 200, 1,052,219 records. RARE FIND: WVDHSEM 911 dataset includes Res_Name + Res_Phone fields. Direct phone-fill source for WV residents — Henri's 1% phone ceiling drops to near-100% for WV leads.
VERIFIED: 1,389,855 polygon parcels. Pair with ParcelSummary table 11 (above) for owner data.

jurisdiction: Canadian County Parcel Data (OKC western metro)
notes: VERIFIED 2026-05-08: HTTP 200, 84,772 records, lastEditDate 2026-04-30 (FRESH). displayField=owners_name. Highest-quality OK source. Covers OKC western suburbs (Yukon, Mustang, El Reno) — fast-growing residential market. Direct ingest. Companion sublayers: 0=Subdivisions, 2=Lots, 4=Blocks.

jurisdiction: Oklahoma Construction Industries Board — License Roster
notes: OK CIB licenses electrical, plumbing, mechanical/HVAC, roofing (commercial+residential). Public search returns license #, name, address, phone, classification, status. Search-only; CIB also publishes downloadable PDF roster on request.

jurisdiction: Maine Parcels Organized Towns (alt service — refreshable)
notes: ME parcel substitute. Non-static, refreshable. Capabilities=Query,Extract,Sync. Pair with the 'Maine Parcels Organized Towns ADB' related table (joined on Parcel_ID) for OWNER1, OWNER2, MAILADDR, BOOK, PAGE, SALEDATE, SALEPRICE, ASSESSED.

ME PFR licenses electricians, plumbers, oil/solid-fuel installers, propane/natural-gas installers (NO general-contractor license in ME). Search-only portal. Returns license #, name, address, license_type, status, expiration.

BORDERLINE FRESHNESS — 108,901 parcels, modified 2024-12-16. MS has NO statewide parcel aggregator; this is the best Gulf Coast substitute. Coastal rebuild work signal. Owner data presence not confirmed; probe field schema before ingest.

jurisdiction: Mississippi State Board of Contractors — License Roster
notes: MS contractor license search (commercial + residential builders, remodelers). Search-only; returns license #, name, address, classification, expiration.

jurisdiction: RI Contractors' Registration & Licensing Board — License Roster
notes: STRONGEST single source for RI contractor leads. RI CRB registers ALL residential contractors (general, remodeling, additions). Public search returns registration_number, name, address, phone, work_classification, insurance_status, complaints. Electrical/plumbing/mechanical separately licensed via DBR.

RI's largest city. VGSI public portal — search by address/owner returns owner_name, mailing_addr, sale_date, sale_price, assessed_value, BUILDING_AREA, YEAR_BUILT, RECENT_PERMITS. Same VGSI pattern serves Warwick, Cranston, Pawtucket. Search-only HTML.
Manchester (NH largest city). VGSI portal — sale_date, sale_price, assessed_val, owner, mailing_addr. Same VGSI pattern across NH municipalities.
OPLC licenses electricians, plumbers, gas-fitters (no GC license in NH). Standard Thentia/Iron Data eLicense. Search-only.
